text:
maria: Hey team — we need to lock the RFC review meeting for next Wed. Who can present / review? Pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-inference-routing and https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-kv-cache-opt. Proposing a 45m meeting (10m per RFC + buffer). Please state availability and which slot you'd like.

josh: I can take the routing RFC (first slot). Morning PST works for me.

li: I'm CET — mornings are tight. I can do ~15:00 CET (which is ~6:00 PST). Prefer the second slot if possible. I'll do pre-read tonight.

sam: I authored the KV cache RFC — happy to present. Need ~20m including Q. Would like a reviewer who has run the perf harness (ping @anita).

anita: I can review KV cache. Quick ask: can you include recent perf snapshots in the pre-read? e.g. 
```
bench: p95=78ms, p99=220ms, cost=0.12$/k-token
```
Will look over slides after those numbers are in.

maria: Thanks — sam, can you add that bench snippet to the doc? Also suggest ordering: 1) routing RFC, 2) KV cache opt, 3) rollout policy (FYI).

calendar-bot: Created event "RFC Review - 2026-03-25" Wed 16:00 UTC — invites sent.

josh: That conflicts with infra stand for me. Can we shift 30m earlier to 15:30 UTC?

li: 15:30 UTC works on my side.

maria: OK shifting to 15:30 UTC. Final agenda draft: 
- 15:30 intros (5m)
- routing RFC (10m pres + 8m Q)
- KV cache opt (20m pres + 10m Q)
- rollout policy FYI (5m)
- actions / next steps (7m)
Please add pre-read comments by EOD Tue so we can triage questions ahead of time.

sam: noted — I'll upload updated slides + perf snapshots by EOD.

anita: I'll prepare a short review template and ping reviewers to fill it out before the meeting.

maria: Great. @josh @li @anita — please react :thumbsup: to confirm you can make 15:30 UTC. I will send a final reminder 24h before with the pinned agenda and review checklist.
